kept.quote: 5. City Council approve the temporary closure of the west sidewalk to pedestrian traffic on Pape Avenue, between Gamble Avenue and Gowan Avenue, from February 1, 2026 to December 31, 2030, inclusive, for the purpose of the Ontario Line Cosburn Station construction.
kept.summary: Council is asked to approve closing the west sidewalk on Pape Avenue between Gamble Avenue and Gowan Avenue from February 1, 2026 to December 31, 2030.
kept.why_it_matters: If the rider walks along the west side of Pape near the Gamble Avenue stop, the walk to or from the stop may need to use the east sidewalk instead.

kept.quote: In addition, Metrolinx will implement new pedestrian crossovers (PXOs) at Gamble Avenue and Gowan Avenue, to provide safe and convenient crossings to the east side of Pape Avenue.
kept.summary: Metrolinx plans new pedestrian crossovers at Gamble Avenue and Gowan Avenue to reach the east side of Pape Avenue.
kept.why_it_matters: A crossing at Gamble Avenue could change how the rider crosses Pape near the boarding stop while the west sidewalk is closed.

kept.quote: With reduced roadway capacity, TTC buses may experience increased travel times within the construction zone, particularly during peak hours.
kept.summary: Buses on Pape Avenue may take longer through the construction zone, especially at peak hours.
kept.why_it_matters: The 72 trip from Gamble Avenue toward Pape Station could take longer, which may mean more time standing or waiting.

kept.quote: The southbound nearside transit stop on Pape Avenue at Cosburn Avenue will be temporarily relocated to south of Gowan Avenue.
kept.summary: The southbound stop on Pape Avenue at Cosburn Avenue will be temporarily moved to south of Gowan Avenue.
kept.why_it_matters: This stop change is close to the Gamble Avenue stop and may affect nearby stop spacing or crowding on the rider's route.
